_doc: Per-tensor fingerprints ([sum, sum|x|] in float64 over F32 elements) of the gitignored tiny checkpoint each committed golden was recorded from. The pin scripts random-initialise these and do not reproduce the same weights across torch/transformers versions, so a checkpoint re-pinned on another box silently pairs a committed golden with different weights and the parity test fails with a meaningless cosine. Numeric, not a file hash: the same seed gives byte-different but ULP-equal checkpoints on arm64 and amd64, which are NOT a mismatch. Checked by requireFixtureIdentity (decoder/fixture_identity_test.go); regenerate with GOINFER_FIXTURE_IDENTITY_UPDATE=1 go test ./decoder/ -run TestFixtureIdentity_update right after the fixture's goldens pass, and commit it with the goldens. See docs/measurements/tiny-fixture-golden-mismatch-2026-09-24.md.
